setup.title: Pet Your Own Cat in the Current Tab
setup.stepBookmark: Show your browser’s bookmarks bar and drag this link onto it, or copy its link address, create a bookmark manually, and paste the full address into the bookmark’s URL field (not the browser’s address bar). {bookmark}
setup.stepOpen: Switch to the open cat-petting tab, or {site}. Click the bookmark you just added and choose the personal HTML generated by the agent. If the file picker does not pop up, click “Choose HTML”.
setup.stepClose: The session opens in the current tab. Click “Close Session”, press Esc, or reload to return to the original site.
setup.hint: Drag “Open My Cat” to your bookmarks bar first, then click the bookmark on the target page.
setup.privacy: Your personal HTML stays on your device and can be reopened next time with the same bookmark.
setup.noScript: Please enable JavaScript so this local setup page can generate the bookmark link.

overlay.wrongSite: Please open https://pet-the-cat.pages.dev/ in a top-level tab before using this launcher.
overlay.title: My Cat
overlay.intro: Please choose the UTF-8 HTML file generated by this skill.
overlay.blocked: The current page’s security policy blocked the personal session from opening.
overlay.invalid: Please choose a v1 personal HTML file generated by this skill.
overlay.openFailed: Could not open the personal session. Please check the file or your browser’s page restrictions.
overlay.readFailed: Failed to read file. Please choose a valid UTF-8 HTML file.
overlay.unavailable: This browser cannot open the session dialog.

session.incompatible: The site HTML is incompatible. Please re-save the current public page verbatim from https://pet-the-cat.pages.dev/ using the download command for your platform in the skill guide; if it still fails, update this Skill.

cli.help: show this help message and exit
cli.langHelp: Language for diagnostics and default cat name (zh-CN, ja, en)
cli.buildDescription: Build a local pet-the-cat session from a downloaded page and two PNGs.
cli.nameHelp: Name shown in the cat selector (optional; defaults to the locale default name)
cli.nameFileHelp: Plain-text file with the cat name (UTF-8 or UTF-16 with BOM; preserves quotes and literal text)
cli.pngSignature: File does not have a PNG signature.
cli.pngEndInvalid: Invalid PNG IEND chunk or trailing data after IEND.
cli.pngEndMissing: PNG is missing a complete IEND chunk.
cli.pngPixels: PNG pixel data is incomplete or has an unexpected size.
cli.pngFilter: PNG scanline uses an invalid filter.
cli.pngHeader: PNG is missing a valid IHDR chunk.
cli.pngPaletteDepth: PNG palette exceeds bit depth capacity.
cli.pngStatic: Textures must use a static PNG.
cli.pngAlpha: PNG requires an alpha channel or tRNS transparency.
cli.pageEncoding: Expected UTF-16 HTML with a BOM.
cli.pageStructure: Page structure or loader hook has changed.
cli.outputExists: {path} already exists; please choose a new output path.
cli.photoDescription: Turn a locally annotated overhead cat photo into two transparent PNGs.
cli.layoutHelp: JSON annotations from references/photo.md with optional body_trims polygons
cli.dirHelp: new directory for body.png and tail.png
cli.inspectHelp: save a half-open box from the oriented photo as edge-NN.png (repeatable). Panels show the photo, final body on light and dark backgrounds, and the body before trims on both backgrounds when applicable
cli.pillowRequired: Please install Pillow 9.1 or newer in the current Python environment (for example: python -m pip install "Pillow>=9.1").
cli.pointOutside: Point ({x}, {y}) is outside the oriented photo ({width} × {height})
cli.maskSize: A mask must match the oriented photo's dimensions
cli.outlinePoints: An outline polygon needs at least three points
cli.trimPoints: {label} must be a polygon with at least three [x, y] points
cli.trimCoordinates: {label} points must be [x, y] pairs of numbers
cli.trimCross: {label} must not cross or touch itself
cli.trimList: body_trims must be an array of polygons
cli.sameAnchors: Head and tail root must be different points
cli.uncovered: Body mask must cover the {anchor} anchor
cli.tailWidths: Give at least three tail points, with positive widths except zero at the cap edge
cli.tailDuplicates: Adjacent tail points must be distinct
cli.tailBend: A tail path needs enough points to follow each bend without doubling back at a point
cli.tailCenter: Tail center becomes transparent at strip x={x}. Check the centerline and tail mask
cli.invalidBox: --inspect-box {left} {top} {right} {bottom} must have positive area within the oriented photo ({width} × {height})
cli.tailNarrowed: Tail width reduced to fit the 200 px strip. Inspect the join in the preview.
